meta.name: momentum-streak-scanner
meta.description: S&P 500 stocks that have closed higher every session for at least N days in a row, ending on the latest close — ranked by streak length, then by the gain made during the streak. Broken streaks are ignored.

min_streak_days.description: Only report a stock whose unbroken run of higher closes is at least this many sessions long.

lookback_days.description: How many calendar days of price history to consider, counted back from the latest close. It only needs to exceed the longest streak you expect to find; it also sets the length of the market-backdrop charts.
